improvement_recommendations.main_focus: Maintain high request success rates and validate reliability under realistic failure conditions.

recommendations.title: Increase evaluation sample size
recommendations.description: Run more requests across different questions and repeated evaluation sessions.

recommendations.title: Test failure scenarios
recommendations.description: Simulate API timeouts, network failures, model errors, and unavailable services.
recommendations.expected_benefit: Verify how the application behaves during failures.

recommendations.title: Validate retry behavior
recommendations.description: Test exponential backoff and retry limits under temporary failures.

recommendations.title: Add timeout handling
recommendations.description: Configure request timeouts and handle slow or unresponsive services safely.

recommendations.title: Add structured error logging
recommendations.description: Record error types, failed requests, retry attempts, and timestamps.

recommendations.title: Monitor production reliability
recommendations.description: Track success rate, error rate, retry rate, and request failures in production.

recommendations.title: Run reliability evaluation regularly
recommendations.description: Include reliability testing in CI/CD or scheduled evaluation runs.
recommendations.expected_benefit: Detect regressions after code or model changes.
